answer: Sequential Proof-of-Elapsed Work. Each identity must complete a spiral of timed challenge rounds, where every round's answer depends on the prior one; skipping breaks the chain. Enrollment requires solving a ferrous-marker puzzle whose solution seeds the first round, so batch creation gains no parallelism. The agent must reach a fixed vertex in the round graph within a wall-clock window, verified by timestamps. An attacker pays sequential compute latency per identity, making mass creation cost real elapsed time, not capital.
